title: 2021-08-17 Devops priority visuals

Goals

How do we create a JIRA board that highlights what we do and work on, and also cater for our different priorities.

Categories of work

In general, there is a need to identify the categories of work that is being done, and visualise them together so that priorities can be set.

Work category

Examples

Rationale

Priority

Development support - Immediate operational

  • Questions in Slack

  • “Please look into my access tokens to the artifacts survey”

  • “Our build pipeline has blown up, please help”

  • Onboarding of new IPEX members

  • Meeting about Sentry to move it further

Efforts here should if possible be diverged to knowledge/how to articles.

Usually the most important work to enable IPEX teams.

Probably the most draining category

Expedite Epic?

Use Jira priority field?

  • High/Highest prio > Full team affected

  • Medium > Single developer affected

Team - Highest prio

Development team support - Plannable

  • Migrations to Github

  • Implementation of new build pipelines

  • Set up new monitoring for specific team

Should minimize efforts here, since most of this should be done by the different teams

Strategic Devops initiatives - Plannable work

  • POC of new Monitoring tool

This is probably the most valuable category of work for the devops team. Efforts here should be maximised
